about: Monday night only: every other Week 5 game is final and graded under Record. BUF @ LA news is the final injury reports (filed Saturday) plus Monday coverage; inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff (6:45 ET). Spread, total and moneyline are the consensus as of Monday; yardage lines are DraftKings from Sun Oct 11. No anytime TD prices have been posted for this game in the free feeds yet. The news is shown next to each pick but is not added to the Desk numbers (books already moved on it).
bar: Players ruled out are dimmed and dropped from the TD and Games tabs.

Lamar Jackson.n: Out (ankle). Tyler Huntley starts; Huntley went 2-0 as a fill-in last season.

Kyle Juszczyk.n: Knee, out a couple of weeks.

Ja'Marr Chase.n: Questionable (concussion); full practice Friday but has to clear the protocol. Trending toward playing.

Justin Jefferson.n: Questionable (ankle), a game-time decision. Says 'that's definitely the plan' to play; O'Connell hasn't committed. Bye next week.

Caleb Williams.n: Questionable (hamstring) after a limited Friday practice, his first in nearly three weeks; Tyson Bagent is still expected to start.

Tyson Bagent.n: Named the starter earlier in the week; Williams is questionable.

Ladd McConkey.n: Questionable (foot) but not expected to play (Rotowire, Oct 11); Tre' Harris is the likely top target.

Jayden Daniels.n: Back from the dislocated elbow; Marcus Mariota is doubtful (knee).

DJ Moore.n: Questionable (shoulder). He aggravated an AC joint sprain against New England and was limited in practice; one analyst calls him on the doubtful side of questionable. If he sits, Kincaid, Shakir and Coleman pick up the targets.

Derrick Henry.n: 23+ carries in three of four games; with Lamar out NBC expects a heavy load.

Jameis Winston.n: Starting; Jaxson Dart is out for the season.

Drew Lock.n: Listed as Seattle's starter in the schedule data.

Jacoby Brissett.n: Listed as Arizona's starter in the schedule data.

Ashton Jeanty.n: Questionable (ankle/foot); missed Friday practice. Rapoport: plantar fasciitis flare-up, decided after a pregame workout. Hopeful to play.

Rico Dowdle.n: Questionable (toe); Schefter reports he is unlikely to play.

Zay Flowers.n: Questionable (foot) but expected to play Sunday night (Schefter).

Alvin Kamara.n: Questionable (back); limited but practiced all week, expected to play.

Marvin Harrison Jr..n: Inactive for Week 5: he is being traded (reported Sunday morning; not yet on the official report).

Christian Benford.n: Back from the toe injury and expected to start.

Aaron Donald.n: Expected to play after missing last week (back).

phi-jax: Inactive for PHI: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown, Jonathan Greenard, Marcus Epps, Drew Kendall. Lane Johnson retired and Cam Jurgens was traded, so the line moved two points to JAX -7.5 after the O-line news.
Inactive for JAX: S Eric Murray, G Daniel Faalele, CB Jaylon Jones, CB Alijah Huzzie and three rookies.
London, 9:30 ET. Jacksonville is 7-7 all time in London.
chi-gb: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is questionable after a limited Friday practice; Tyson Bagent is still expected to start. Kyle Monangai is out.
GB: Chris Brooks (ankle) and Savion Williams (ankle) out. The total moved from 45.5 to 47.5 since Friday.
The Bears' defense has held three straight opponents to 12 points or fewer (Covers).
cin-mia: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor/neck) are questionable; Chase practiced fully Friday. Andrei Iosivas is out.
De'Von Achane is still out for Miami. The total fell from 48.5 to about 42.5 on the Bengals' receiver news.
Miami is averaging about 11.5 points per game.
lv-ne: LV: Ashton Jeanty (ankle/foot) decided after a pregame workout (plantar fasciitis flare, Rapoport); Jalen Nailor and Dont'e Thornton out, Jack Bech on IR.
NE: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) expected to play; A.J. Brown and Harold Landry on reserve lists; Mack Hollins to IR.
The Patriots have had multiple turnovers in five straight games, the longest active streak.
min-no: Justin Jefferson (ankle) is a game-time decision and says he plans to play; Jordan Addison (hamstring) questionable. Alvin Kamara (back) questionable but expected to play.
G Donovan Jackson is out (meniscus); LT Christian Darrisaw was in the concussion protocol.
New Orleans throws on about two-thirds of its snaps and has scored 24+ in all four games.
cle-nyj: CLE DTs Mason Graham and Mike Hall Jr. likely out (ankle).
NYJ: Breece Hall (quad) and Adonai Mitchell (finger) out; Tim Patrick questionable.
Cleveland has won three straight on defense; the Jets scored 12 in Week 4.
ind-pit: IND: Darius Slayton (knee) and Ashton Dulin out; C Tanor Bortolini expected out. Keenan Allen was a rest day only.
PIT: Michael Pittman (foot) out; Rico Dowdle (toe) unlikely to play per Schefter. CBs Jalen Ramsey (wrist) and Jamel Dean (ankle) did not practice.
Pittsburgh played Thursday in Week 4 (10 days of rest); Indianapolis is back from London with no bye.
hou-ten: Both teams are winless. Houston is 0-4 against the spread.
No major skill-position injuries found in the Week 5 reports.
nyg-was: Jayden Daniels is back from the dislocated elbow; Marcus Mariota is doubtful (knee).
WAS: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) a game-time decision; Stefon Diggs out. NYG: Cam Skattebo limited (shoulder). Spread down from 4.5 to 3.5.
Jaxson Dart is out for the season; Jameis Winston starts.
den-lac: DEN CB Pat Surtain II is out (ankle); CB Riley Moss was also hurt in Week 4.
LAC: Ladd McConkey (foot) not expected to play and Quentin Johnston out; both starting tackles left last week's game. LAC moneyline lengthened to -192.
Denver scores a league-low 3.3 first-half points per game.
det-ari: Marvin Harrison Jr. is inactive: he is being traded (reported Sunday morning). Arizona's TD and yardage prices on this page are from Friday, before the news, so his targets going to Michael Wilson, Trey McBride and the other receivers aren't priced in yet.
DET CB Rock Ya-Sin is out; Detroit has allowed 17 touchdowns, most in the NFL.
Arizona is 29th in points allowed (29.3 per game).
sf-sea: SF: Nick Bosa listed out (SI); Kyle Juszczyk out a couple of weeks.
SEA: Zach Charbonnet out; Jadarian Price on IR; Leonard Williams uncertain.
Seattle has allowed the fewest passing yards in the league; SF has allowed zero sacks on 113 dropbacks.
bal-atl: Lamar Jackson (ankle) and Trey Hendrickson (finger) are out. Tyler Huntley starts.
Zay Flowers (foot) expected to play (Schefter). Spread down from 3.5 to 3.
Derrick Henry has 23+ carries in three of four games.
Atlanta has the league's No. 1 run defense (48.3 rushing yards allowed per game); Atlanta is 2-5 all time vs Baltimore.
buf-la: BUF final report: Ed Oliver (knee) and WR Josh Palmer (shoulder, hurt in Friday's practice) are out. DJ Moore (shoulder), CB Dee Alford (ankle) and DL Landon Jackson (knee) are questionable.
CB Christian Benford (toe) practiced fully and is expected to start after missing last week.
LA final report: only S Quentin Lake (hip) is questionable. Aaron Donald (back) is expected to play after missing last week; Tyler Higbee and Alaric Jackson had rest days but carry no game status.
Buffalo leads the league in scoring but allows 26+ points per game; it lost its first game last week to New England.
tb-dal: Final: TB 24, DAL 16. Bucky Irving ran for 165 yards; Tampa Bay outscored Dallas 17-0 in the third quarter.
Dallas lost CeeDee Lamb (quad) and LT Tyler Guyton (back) in the fourth quarter.
